steps.text: Prepare the coffee. Make an intense moka coffee and let it cool completely (you can use an ice bath to speed up the process).
Whip the yolks with the sugar. Place the 12 yolks and the sugar in a bowl or mixer and whip at high speed for 3-4 minutes, until you get an airy and lighter-colored mixture.
Incorporate the mascarpone. Add the mascarpone and start working at low speed, increasing progressively to maximum power for about 5 minutes, until you get a firm, dense, and well-whipped cream.
Prepare the base. Place a thin layer of cream at the bottom of the container (this helps set the assembly).

Assemble the tiramisu. - Dip the savoiardi in the coffee: 1-2 seconds per side, without soaking them excessively. - Place a first layer of well-fitted biscuits. - Add a layer of cream (approx. half a centimeter). - Repeat the process with another layer of biscuits and finish with a final layer of cream.
Rest. Cover and let rest in the refrigerator for between 8 and 12 hours so it sets and the flavors integrate.
Finish. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of bitter cocoa on top.
